A molten or dissolved ionic compound that conducts electricity and is broken down during electrolysis.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Electrochemistry — a core area of GCSE Chemistry.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Electrochemistry brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Electrochemistry.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
